channel.title: Thai Regulatory Watch — practice-cybersecurity-technology
channel.description: Public observations for review. Newest source publication first, falling back to source modification. Undated items follow dated items; no pubDate is invented. Date-only pubDate uses midnight UTC for presentation, not a known publication time. Practice source coverage: 9/11 healthy. Incomplete coverage: mdes-watch, nbtc-listing-01. No new feed entries is not proof of no regulatory updates. Legal effect is Not assessed. RSS window: 500. Full history: https://attorneynoon.github.io/thai-regulatory-watch/api/v1/events.json
